entries.purpose: Send bounded alert and Relay health notifications.
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records bot issuance and chat authorization time.
entries.expiration_policy: Provider expiry is recorded when defined; rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually and after any display, log, or suspected exposure.
entries.revocation_procedure: Revoke the bot token with the provider, remove the chat grant, and keep notification delivery disabled until replacement validation passes.
entries.rollback_policy: Rollback uses a separately retained disabled generation only during the bounded cutover window.

entries.purpose: Authenticate n8n to its internal PostgreSQL database.
entries.required_when: The n8n PostgreSQL service is enabled
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records role and password creation time.
entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory; passwords do not receive indefinite status.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually and after database restore or suspected exposure.
entries.revocation_procedure: Disable or replace the PostgreSQL role credential and restart only the dependent n8n service.
entries.rollback_policy: Keep the prior password disabled but recoverable only through the bounded database rollback procedure.

entries.purpose: Authenticate the alert-store PostgreSQL shadow and asset stores.
entries.required_when: Any alert-store PostgreSQL-backed store is enabled
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records role and password creation time.
entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually and after restore or suspected exposure.
entries.revocation_procedure: Disable or replace the dedicated PostgreSQL role credential and keep shadow/asset features disabled until validation passes.
entries.rollback_policy: Rollback is limited to the prior disabled database generation during the verified cutover window.

entries.purpose: Authorize allowlisted loopback asset mutations.
entries.required_when: PostgreSQL-backed asset, software, or AC Hunter stores are enabled
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records random token generation time.
entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least every 180 days and after suspected exposure.
entries.revocation_procedure: Remove the token from all clients and alert-store, then restart only after the replacement matches.
entries.rollback_policy: Retain the prior disabled generation for one bounded smoke-test window.

entries.purpose: Authenticate Relay and alert-store post-commit requests to n8n.
entries.required_when: Post-commit delivery or legacy Relay webhook rollback is enabled
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records one shared generation and each provisioned endpoint.
entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least every 180 days with paired endpoint validation.
entries.revocation_procedure: Disable both routes, remove the old n8n variable and runtime copies, then provision one matching replacement generation.
entries.rollback_policy: Rollback requires the immediately prior matching generation at every endpoint and is revoked after the cutover window.

entries.purpose: Authenticate Relay PCAP broker requests to the n8n proxy.
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records one shared generation and both provisioned endpoints.
entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least every 180 days with claim/progress/completion smoke tests.
entries.revocation_procedure: Disable the broker, remove both copies, and provision one matching replacement generation.
entries.rollback_policy: Rollback uses only the immediately prior matching generation during a bounded no-new-claim window.

entries.purpose: Authorize one isolated controlled-evaluation runtime.
entries.creation_evidence: The controlled launcher records generation time in its sealed run manifest.
entries.expiration_policy: Expires with the controlled run and is never a production credential.
entries.rotation_policy: Generate a fresh random token for every run.
entries.revocation_procedure: Terminate the controlled runtime and destroy its isolated environment.
entries.rollback_policy: No token rollback is permitted; rerun with a new isolated token.

entries.purpose: Authenticate operator access to administrative dashboard actions.
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only record metadata and lifecycle inventory carry the password generation time.
entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually and after suspected exposure.
entries.revocation_procedure: Replace the password record and invalidate all sessions.
entries.rollback_policy: Password rollback is not permitted; recover through an operator-controlled reset.

entries.purpose: Bind authenticated browser sessions to the dashboard service.
entries.creation_evidence: Runtime session metadata records creation time.
entries.expiration_policy: Every session has a fixed expiry enforced by the runtime.
entries.rotation_policy: Regenerate the service token on recovery and create new sessions after expiry.
entries.revocation_procedure: Delete the session state and regenerate the service token.
entries.rollback_policy: Session-secret rollback is forbidden.

entries.purpose: Authenticate the dedicated read-only AC Hunter service account.
entries.required_when: AC Hunter Deep Review is enabled
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records upstream account creation time.
entries.expiration_policy: Upstream expiry is recorded when defined; rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually and after upstream account or TLS changes.
entries.revocation_procedure: Disable the upstream account and integration, then remove the local credential file.
entries.rollback_policy: Retain the prior disabled upstream generation only for the bounded read-only cutover test.

entries.purpose: Authorize the isolated Hermes OpenAI Codex provider.
entries.required_when: Hermes Agent is enabled for an assigned role
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only dedicated auth metadata records provider issuance information.
entries.expiration_policy: Provider expiration is preserved and checked inside the dedicated auth store.
entries.rotation_policy: Refresh only in the isolated profile and atomically persist the filtered replacement.
entries.revocation_procedure: Revoke the provider grant and remove the dedicated Onion Sentinel auth store.
entries.rollback_policy: Atomic file replacement preserves the previous file only through the controlled backup/restore workflow.

entries.purpose: Authenticate bounded Security Onion PCAP stream manifests.
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records local key generation time.
entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually with in-flight stream drain and manifest verification.
entries.revocation_procedure: Stop new streams, replace the host-local key, and reject manifests from the retired generation.
entries.rollback_policy: Rollback is allowed only before new-generation manifests are accepted.

entries.purpose: Authenticate the optional abuseipdb enrichment source.
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records the provider issuance time.
entries.expiration_policy: Provider expiry is recorded when defined; otherwise rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually and immediately after suspected exposure.
entries.revocation_procedure: Revoke the provider credential in its administrative console and disable the source until replacement qualifies.
entries.rollback_policy: Retain the prior disabled generation only during the bounded synthetic-verified cutover window.

entries.purpose: Pull sanitized recent alerts from Security Onion.
entries.creation_evidence: Owner-only lifecycle inventory records key generation and independently verified host-pin time.
entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually with forced-command negative tests.
entries.revocation_procedure: Remove the exact public-key line on Security Onion and destroy the Relay private key.
entries.rollback_policy: Keep the prior public key disabled and re-enable only during the bounded pull smoke-test window.

entries.purpose: Stream one bounded PCAP window from Security Onion.

entries.expiration_policy: rotation_due_at is mandatory.
entries.rotation_policy: Rotate at least annually after draining in-flight streams.
entries.revocation_procedure: Remove the exact PCAP forced-command public key and destroy the Relay private key.
entries.rollback_policy: Rollback is allowed only before a new-generation stream is admitted.
